about: GeM (Government e-Marketplace, bidplus.gem.gov.in): public bid-result pages (every bidder, offered make/model, technical result, quotes) and bid documents (PDF). India-only site: fetching runs on the pool's India servers; parsing the stored PDFs (pdfparse) runs on GitHub runners.
setup: command -v pdftotext >/dev/null || { sudo -n apt-get update -qq && sudo -n apt-get install -y -qq poppler-utils; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
